verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch is clearly driven through documented public interfaces. The evidence links to a REST API reference (the RRF page under reference/elasticsearch/rest-apis) and cites a documented inference API, Query DSL and ES|QL docs, and "one API" for vector, hybrid and reranking. It also has official language clients with a forward-compatibility policy, an official MCP server and official agent skills. Missing for 10: direct excerpts from the core REST API reference rather than indirect links, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes at candidate paths returned 404), an llms.txt or markdown docs for agents (both 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
